# REST API: Whoami

These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `GET /api/v1/whoami`

Show who is calling

Answers with the name and type of the principal the credential signs in as and, for a task or CI token, the scope of that token. Any valid credential may ask. `admin` says whether the caller holds the `ADMIN` role on the instance and may use the administrator routes with this credential (never with a task or CI token), `has_access` whether it has any grant at all (any scope, directly or through a group), `may_deploy` whether it may deploy in at least one environment with this credential, `secret_environments` the environments where it may manage secrets with it, `manage_policy` whether it may manage row filters and column masks with it, `reads_environments` whether it may read at least one environment with it (and so the repositories), and `instance_actions` the actions it may take on the instance with it: the web interface shows the administration areas, tells a new person to ask for access, shows the deploy steps of Home and offers its Secrets, Row filters & masks and Repositories pages, and the instance-wide actions of Settings, from these seven. `picture` is the etag of your profile picture, or `null` without one.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `WhoamiOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `WhoamiOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `type` | one of `USER`, `SERVICE_ACCOUNT` | yes |  |
| `task_token` | `TaskTokenScopeOut` or null | yes |  |
| `ci_token` | `CiTokenScopeOut` or null | no |  |
| `language` | text or null | no |  |
| `admin` | true or false | no |  |
| `has_access` | true or false | no |  |
| `may_deploy` | true or false | no |  |
| `secret_environments` | list of text | no |  |
| `manage_policy` | true or false | no |  |
| `reads_environments` | true or false | no |  |
| `instance_actions` | list of text | no |  |
| `picture` | text or null | no |  |

## `PATCH /api/v1/whoami`

Set your preferred language

Catalog texts are then shown in it unless a request asks for another (`lang`). Any person may set their own; a task or CI token may not (403). Answers 422 for a value that is not a language tag.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `ProfileIn`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | text or null | yes |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `WhoamiOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `WhoamiOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `type` | one of `USER`, `SERVICE_ACCOUNT` | yes |  |
| `task_token` | `TaskTokenScopeOut` or null | yes |  |
| `ci_token` | `CiTokenScopeOut` or null | no |  |
| `language` | text or null | no |  |
| `admin` | true or false | no |  |
| `has_access` | true or false | no |  |
| `may_deploy` | true or false | no |  |
| `secret_environments` | list of text | no |  |
| `manage_policy` | true or false | no |  |
| `reads_environments` | true or false | no |  |
| `instance_actions` | list of text | no |  |
| `picture` | text or null | no |  |
